items.note: Row 3 (court-emancipated 17-year-old needing surgery) repeated bank item nb:nb26-moca-022; changed it to a minor on active military duty. Tightened the STI rationale so it is accurate in every state (some states set a minimum age, all below 16).

Unsafe-dose chain-of-command sequence duplicated bank items nb:u2-mocb-025 and nb:lead-06. Rewrote as an ordered item on the CUS speaking-up script and escalation when a provider breaks maximal sterile barrier precautions during central line insertion.

Ethical decision-making sequence duplicated bank item nb:nb26-mocb-039, and the order of 'gather facts' vs 'identify the problem' differs between textbook models (no single defensible sequence). Rewrote as an MCQ on refusing to co-sign an unwitnessed controlled-substance waste.

Incident-report SATA duplicated bank items nb:nb26-sabc-013, nb:nb26-core-049 and nb:u2-moca-020 (fall incident report: objective facts, no blame, not in chart). Rewrote as a SATA on grounds for board of nursing discipline.

Documentation SATA repeated bank items nb:nb26-moca-036 and nb:nb26-mocb-015 option for option (timely charting, client quotes, late entries, charting for a coworker, charting before giving, approved abbreviations). Rewrote as an evaluateOutcomes SATA on professional accountability under the ANA Code.

Keyed option 'IV morphine 20 minutes ago, form not yet signed' repeated bank item nb:u2-moca-010. Replaced it with a client who has a court-appointed health care guardian (legal authority problem); key count unchanged.

Married 17-year-old consenting for herself repeated the emancipated-minor fact in bank item nb:nb26-moca-022 and in row 3 of ethics-001, and marriage-based emancipation depends on state law. Rewrote as an MCQ on recognizing defamation.

Single-line correction of a paper charting error repeated an option of bank item nb:nb26-moca-036. Rewrote as an MCQ on honoring a client's choice of visitor and support person (same-sex partner) over family objection.

Float nurse declining an untrained skill repeated bank item nb:nb26-moca-039 (float to NICU, accept tasks within competence). Rewrote as an MCQ on a nurse refusing to care for a client because of HIV status.
Distractors 2 and 4 tested the same idea (declining overtime vs declining an extra shift). Replaced distractor 4 with calling in sick per policy before the shift.
Telephone prescription read-back repeated rnr:leadership-048 and bank nb:u2-mocb-034. Rewrote as a safety MCQ on holding and verifying a medication the client says is unfamiliar.

Elder-neglect SATA repeated bank item nb:nb26-core-035 (stage 3 pressure injury, soiled clothing in an older adult with a caregiver child), and "must report" depends on state elder-abuse law. Rewrote as a safety SATA on recognizing do-not-use abbreviations and dose expressions.

Time-out left/right knee discrepancy repeated bank item nb:nb26-mocb-024 almost word for word. Rewrote as a safety MCQ on unlabeled syringes on a sterile field (Joint Commission medication labeling goal).
Wrong-client metoprolol error repeated rnr:pharmacology-041 and bank nb:u2-moca-026. Rewrote as a safety prioritization MCQ for a charge nurse choosing among four safety concerns.
